title: Apl.de.ap says new EP is a ‘shoutout’ to leaders to care for the Philippines
summary: Filipino-American rapper Apl.de.Ap said his new EP, “PPP” (Power to the Pilipino People), serves as a message to leaders and people in positions of power to prioritize the Philippines and its people.…

blocks.text: Filipino-American rapper Apl.de.Ap said his new EP, “PPP” (Power to the Pilipino People), serves as a message to leaders and people in positions of power to prioritize the Philippines and its people. Released under GMA Music, the three-track EP marks the Black Eyed Peas member’s first solo project outside the group. It centers on love, hope and peace, drawing inspiration from Filipino culture, values and identity. One of its tracks, “Why,” is a collaboration with OPM rockstar Bamboo that explores the beauty and heartbreak of loving one’s country. “‘Why’ is a love letter to the country.
